dialogues.speaker: Oprichnik
dialogues.text: Hey, you. Do you know what happens to people who go sneaking about where they shouldn't?

dialogues.speaker: Suspicious Person
dialogues.text: ...I guess I'm finding out right about now! Look, this is all a bit new to me — I'm still learning the ropes... How about you give me another chance?

dialogues.speaker: Suspicious Person
dialogues.text: Just give me one more chance — I promise you, you won't catch me next time!

dialogues.speaker: Oprichnik
dialogues.text: Did you take a knock to the head? We're not letting a single one of you <color=#00E1FFFF>thieving rats</color> escape!

dialogues.speaker: Suspicious Person
dialogues.text: Listen, that girl's probably run off with everything by now. Do you really have time to be standing about arguing with the likes of me?

dialogues.speaker: Oprichnik
dialogues.text: There's no need for you to worry about her. You're coming with us!
